activeSlice.scope: Make the disposable persisted Vercel Hunter shadow anchor satisfy the unchanged canonical Hunter readiness contract by writing six explicit source-backed inferred fixture fields after normal public-reference bootstrap. The target user Brand remains read-only, the fixture remains temporary, and all one-shot evidence gates remain explicit.
successCriteria: The Vercel fixture uses active source records derived from Vercel About and Vercel Acceptable Use Policy public references.
Exactly the six canonical Hunter readiness groups receive at least one non-placeholder source-backed inferred field: business, offerings, audience, positioning, topics and boundaries.
No owner-confirmed field is created and no existing user Brand field is modified.
The unchanged createBrandBrainActivationSnapshot readiness evaluator must return hunterReady=true before the fixture can enter the evidence cohort.
Missing About or policy source evidence fails closed before paired evidence starts.
The disposable Brand is deleted after success or failure.
The evidence cohort remains at least 3 distinct real Brands and 30 paired V1/V2 runs.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no canary or production enablement is introduced.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
